title: Who played the Absinthe House before and after
summary: He recalls a Jitney dance before them and the melon pickers possibly after.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Who replaced you in the old Absinthe House?
I see you. I think after we left there, they cut the dancing out. I don't remember. And who was there before you? I think the melon pickers played in there a while. Oh, yeah.
Who was there before you? Do you remember?
Well, it was the Jitney dance before we went in there.
Oh, I thought maybe that was when the original Dixieland Jazz Band came in. No, no. No, that's a nice picture.
That's, uh, Mr. Russell gave it in. Mm-hmm.
Oh, I see. And it says leader on your cap. What does that mean? Well, I was a leader. Yeah, but I mean, I'm trying to get at what's the difference between leader and manager?
